answer_2.quote: We evaluate the performance by using two different evaluation metrics for this new task. Font Recall (FR) ... F-score For each instance X from the test set, we select the top k = {1, 3 and 5} fonts with the highest probabilities from both ground truth and prediction distributions. Then we compute weighted averaged F1-score for each k.

answer_4.quote: In an MTurk experiment, we asked nine annotators to label each sample text by selecting their top three fonts ... We included carefully-designed quality questions in 10 percent of the hits to monitor the quality of our labeling.
answer_4.guideline: Workers were asked to choose suitable fonts after reading the sentence ... we treat the first, second, and third choices differently as they represent the workers' priorities.
